decision.rule: A separate preregistered transport-path study is materially motivated by this local diagnostic only if median paired cold-minus-in-process phase delta is at least 100 ms, or cold-subprocess p95 exceeds 1000 ms while in-process p95 is at most 1000 ms. Meeting the rule motivates a distinct study; it does not authorize a code change, infer provider latency, correct the prior EXP-073 timing, or make any quality/adoption claim.

timing_caveat: All reported exchange times are local offline fixture timings. They are not estimates of provider latency. Paired deltas compare these diagnostic paths only; no prior EXP-073 measurement was adjusted.
